evidence.description: Hardware display update routine uses literal @ 0x00230F34 (value 0xB100D000). Waits for bit 0 clear, writes display data, sets bit 0 to trigger update.

GPIO base 0xB8001000 accessed with indirect addressing pattern. Port offsets: A=+0x00, B=+0x40, C=+0x80, D=+0xC0. Register offsets per port: OMD=+0x10 (Output Mode), PUEN=+0x14 (Pull-Up Enable), DOUT=+0x18 (Data Output), PIN=+0x1C (Pin Input)
GPIO control register map shows GP_BA = 0xB8001000 with register layout matching firmware usage
